items.title: Hide the main window
items.description: Start a task, close the main window, and confirm the pill remains visible while work continues.

items.title: Return to the same conversation
items.description: Click the pill and confirm the original conversation opens with its latest messages.

items.title: Save and reopen this review
items.description: Record an outcome and a note, save the draft, close the document, and reopen it. Confirm the saved answers are retained.
